title: Suggestion: Add optional alert for "Low phone battery"
symptom: The user suggests adding an optional alert for low phone battery in AndroidAPS because many phone operating systems do not provide a customizable low battery alert. If the phone shuts down during the night due to low battery, the user will not get alerts for low or high blood sugar levels and looping stops, potentially leading to prolonged hyperglycemia.
evidence_quote: Since many phone operating systems don't provide a setting for a customizable low battery alert (e.g. battery <10 %) I think it would be very helpful to have this as an option in AAPS.
